title: Responsive Design
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Responsive
learningObjectives: Explain why a responsive MicroSim splits the canvas into a fixed-height drawing region and a separate control region
Trace how windowResized() recomputes the canvas width and repositions the slider controls on every resize event
Predict how narrowing the browser window changes both the drawing area and the width of the sliders beneath it
Distinguish width-responsive layout, where height stays fixed, from fully fluid layout that scales both dimensions
Design a layout where control widths are computed from the container width rather than hard-coded in pixels
